# Location scope: Eurasian frontier regions eligible for Eastern Frontier Protectorate (Duhu).
oe_sub_duhu_region = {
    OR = {
        region = region:xinjiang_region
        region = region:manchuria_region
        region = region:mongolia_region
        region = region:indochina_region
        region = region:tibet_region
        region = region:west_siberia_region
        region = region:east_siberia_region
        region = region:steppes_region
        region = region:khorasan_region
    }
}

# Country scope: whether a country holds the authority to establish Eastern Frontier Protectorates (Duhu).
oe_sub_can_establish_duhu = {
    OR = {
        has_or_had_tag = CHI
        has_or_had_tag = YUA
        AND = {
            exists = international_organization:middle_kingdom
            is_leader_of_international_organization = international_organization:middle_kingdom
        }
        AND = {
            country_rank = country_rank:rank_empire
            any_subject = {
                capital ?= { oe_sub_duhu_region = yes }
            }
        }
    }
}

# Country scope: subject is one of the 4 v9.5 custom subject types.
oe_sub_is_custom_subject = {
    OR = {
        is_subject_type = oe_sub_foederati
        is_subject_type = oe_sub_charter_city
        is_subject_type = oe_sub_brother_kingdom
        is_subject_type = oe_sub_protectorate_duhu
    }
}

# Country scope: subject has another sibling subject under scope:actor that it is feuding with.
oe_sub_has_feud_target = {
    scope:actor = {
        any_subject = {
            NOT = { this = root }
            OR = {
                is_at_war_with = root
                is_rival_of = root
                opinion = { target = root value < 0 }
            }
        }
    }
}
